title: Terrible Arsenals
description: Adds nearly two dozen craftable, low-quality swords.
body:
Ever wanted a sword made out of bread? How about leather? Or rotten flesh? Terrible Arsenals has you covered. These not-so-legendary weapons have low damage outputs and break easily, but can you resist the novelty of slaying your foes with a weapon made from delicate feathers?

This array of swords can be made from:

- Amethyst Shards
- Bamboo
- Blaze Rods
- Bone
- Bread
- Cactus
- Carrots
- Emeralds
- Eyes of Ender
- Feathers
- Glass
- Honeycombs
- Kelp
- Lapis Lazuli
- Leather
- Melon Slices
- Mushrooms
- Paper
- Pufferfish
- Rose Bushes
- Rotten Flesh
- Sticks
- String

Assemble your terrible arsenal and go wild!
